messages:
Priya Nair: AM triage — 27 open tickets, 4 P1s (2 infra, 2 billing). Embedding endpoint saw timeout surge overnight. Anyone on embeds?
Sam Liu: I'm looking, saw 502s from the embed service. grabbing logs now. trace: 7890ab
oncall-bot: Alert: embeddings-prod latency > 1s (5m avg) — triggered at 1951230110
Sam Liu: quick check: I can repro with batch size=32. running a repro job:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"input": ["test"]}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY'
```
Sam Liu: workaround: routing small batches (<=8) avoids timeout for now. pushing a canary patch to reduce max_batch_size in kube config
Alex Park: FYI I updated the "Small-batch" macro to include the workaround. Suggest adding a sentence that recommends batch_size <=8 for embeds during incidents. Proposed macro:
```
Macro: EMBEDS_SLOW
Text: "If embeddings slow/timeout, try batching <=8 and switch to /v1/embeddings?sync=true. If persists, escalate to eng-oncall with logs and trace id."
```
Jordan M.: Can someone review my CR that pins model-variant 1.2.3 to reduce memory churn? PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/421
Maya: I'll review in 30m. @Jordan M. ping me when it's ready for merge.
Priya Nair: Owner assignment: Sam (investigate + rollback plan), Alex (macro + support doc tweak), Jordan (PR for model pin). I'll follow up at 11:30 for status. :white_check_mark:
Sam Liu: confirmed rollback plan ready if canary fails. adding steps to incident doc.
Alex Park: pushed macro change to support/macros.md and created a short blurb in support console (help center). Link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/support/embeds-troubleshoot
Priya Nair: thanks team. If anyone picks up overnight, leave a short note here. Next update 11:30.
